name: mac-tracker-inbox
goal: Mac Needs you uses the shared inbox over the local Tracker API and commits only explicitly confirmed writes, with stale attention rejected atomically.

evidence: Electron home opens the shared inbox backed by local Tracker. Confirm/cancel note, flag and answer; a replaced question rejects an old review without a journal write. Verify with disposable SQLite and built Electron.
Shared Renderer inbox uses the trusted Electron transport. Tracker GET and POST run against the loopback API, with the reviewed flag or answer revision checked under the journal writer lock.

Native tests on harbor-mbp-2 reproduced missing Home entry at desktop, tablet and mobile widths, then passed every width at f88e01ac6b. Eight paired-iOS Chromium cases passed. Disposable SQLite recorded confirmed writes and rejected the stale answer.
